ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 1, in $ \triangle DEF$, $\angle DEF=90^\circ$, $\angle D=30^\circ$. Let B be a moving point on the hypotenuse DF. Construct AB $\perp$ DF at B, intersecting side DE (or side EF) at point A. Let BD $= x$, and the area of $\triangle ABD = y$. Figure 2 is the graph of the function of y with respect to x. What is the maximum area of $\triangle ABD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} It can be observed from the diagram that point A reaches point E, the area of $\triangle ABD$ is maximized. At this juncture, $DB=12$, \\
$AB=DB\cdot \tan 30^\circ=12\times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}=4\sqrt{3}$, \\
$\therefore S_{\triangle ABD}=\frac{1}{2}\times 12\times 4\sqrt{3}=\boxed{24\sqrt{3}}$.
